mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the surface and then adding deeper support and blood supply showed that healing involves more than covering the cut.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting fibres and new skin cells felt somewhat repetitive, though the pictures showed why neither alone closed the wound.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the clot to be cleared after the skin closed; it was temporary, while the supporting fibres remained.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and named wound slots made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: seeing the separate repair pieces become a working whole was interesting, although some preparation steps felt repetitive.
